# The examples a stranger can paste from our docs and from `help` output that are
# not yet executed by a test through the comparator (SPEC-TOOLWORK §7 rule 7).
#
# Every $  line in a fenced block of README.md, docs/USAGE.md, docs/CLI.md and
# docs/nova-swarm-quickstart.md, and every example: line of every `help`, is
# either executed by a test through onboarding.CompareTranscript or listed here.
# The list only shrinks: a new entry fails the class test on the PR.
# Remove an entry when a test exercising it through the comparator lands.
#
# THE LIST ONLY SHRINKS. TestIssue2218 checks it: an entry that does not match
# any real pasted example is a stale entry and a red run.
